topic.readerProblem: A marketer, SEO lead or agency owner is considering Rankscale and wants to know what it does, what the credit-based pricing really costs, and what to check before paying.
topic.connection: AEOeye audits what AI engines say about a brand; the page helps readers decide between a recurring tracker and a one-time audit, and uses AEOeye's crawler study for a neutral fact box on Rankscale's own site.

assessment: A documentation-based guide, not a hands-on review: it reports what Rankscale's pricing page, homepage and llms.txt say (five plans, credits, rollover multipliers, per-engine credit costs, beta labels, inconsistent audit-check counts), shows the credit arithmetic with stated assumptions, and lists seven pre-purchase checks grounded in the SparkToro inconsistency study. It does not claim anything about Rankscale's data accuracy or results, does not rank it, and marks vendor claims (17+ engines, 1000+ users) as unverified.

sources.supports: Plans: Essentials from $20 ($17 yearly, 'Yearly only'), Pro $99 (1,200 credits, up to 4,800 answers, 10 dashboards, 50 audits, 7-day free trial), Pro+ $229 (3,000 / 12,000 / 25 / 100, REST API), Growth $385 (5,500 / 22,000 / 50 / 200), Enterprise $780 (12,000 / 48,000 / 100 / 200); 15% yearly saving; rollover up to 2x (Pro, Pro+) and 3x (Growth, Enterprise); calculator credit costs 0.25 (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, AI Mode), 1 (DeepSeek), 2 (Claude); GUI vs API engine list; extra dashboard slots buyable in-app.

Homepage claims: 17+ engines, 1000+ active users, no per-engine upsell, '94+ technical checkpoints' and '200+ Factors' for page audits, GA4/Search Console (beta), Recommendations (beta), Query Fanouts, prompt volume by 'semantic reconstruction', sign-up required with plan or free trial.
llms.txt exists and links features, FAQ and terms pages; imprint names Rankscale GmbH.
Google says AI Overviews and AI Mode may use a 'query fan-out' technique, issuing multiple related searches.
600 volunteers, 12 prompts, 3 tools, 2,961 runs; under a 1-in-100 chance of the same brand list in any two ChatGPT or Google AI responses (confirmed in raw HTML text).
